title: ModelPrediction
description: Standardized prediction output contract produced by Person 2 quantitative research and machine learning models in NOVA (Interface Contract B)

model_version.description: Semantic version or artifact checksum of the trained/evaluated model

prediction_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the prediction was generated

input_cutoff_timestamp.description: Point-in-time timestamp: no market information beyond this moment was used (strictly <= prediction_timestamp)

instrument_id.description: Target ticker symbol or cross-asset identifier

horizon_bars.description: Forecast horizon duration in candle bars (strictly positive integer)

prediction_value.description: Primary numerical forecast. Strictly finite float (no NaN, +inf, -inf)

prediction_distribution.description: Optional quantile breakdown (e.g. q10, q50, q90) or discrete regime probabilities

confidence_or_uncertainty.description: Model heuristic confidence or uncertainty penalty in [0.0, 1.0]

availability_status.description: Model inference readiness and data-quality status

metadata.description: Lineage metadata: configuration fingerprint, training dataset ID, random seed, feature names
